name: Mei Fong Tan
bio:
Mei Fong Tan is a marketing coordinator with a passion for motorsport ignited during her university days, spent volunteering at the Singapore Grand Prix. Her background in communications and media studies provides a strong foundation for crafting engaging marketing campaigns. After graduating from the National University of Singapore, she worked at a local advertising agency before making the jump to motorsport.

Mei Fong believes in a data-driven approach, meticulously tracking campaign performance and adjusting strategies for optimal results. She is known for her ability to identify emerging trends and translate them into effective marketing initiatives. Her dedication to building strong brand awareness and fan engagement makes her a valuable asset to any team. Mei's strong work ethic and attention to detail are hallmarks of her professional approach.

 Mei is drawn to motorsport for its blend of technical precision and human drama. She aims to elevate Team Penske's marketing efforts by telling compelling stories that resonate with a global audience.

physical.hairStyle: Long, straight hair with subtle highlights, usually tied in a neat ponytail.
physical.description: Mei is of average height with a lean build, often seen wearing stylish glasses.

quirks: Always has a meticulously organized workspace, with color-coded files.
Insists on using a specific brand of imported green tea, brewed precisely at 80 degrees Celsius.
Frequently uses motorsport analogies in everyday conversation.
